update.notes:
Flutter Deck 0.4.1 Beta
New in Mega Man Legends: - Gamepad buttons screen: choose what each button of an Xbox or PlayStation 5 pad does, and set the stick dead zone. - Jet Skates: fire and lock on while skating. Hold Circle to put the skates on, press Circle to take them off. Three new switches in Settings, all on by default. - New lock-on marker, on by default. Optional right-stick flick to switch target. - In-game overlay: Pause, Full screen, Take screenshot, Mute and a game volume bar now work. - Widescreen: the white gaps at the left and right edges of outdoor scenes are fixed.
New in the launcher: - The message board on the Home screen now shows real notices from the developer.
IMPORTANT: a launcher update replaces the launcher only. To get the new game features, install the new Setup or zip, then press "Build my game" again. Games you built with 0.4.0 do not have them yet.
This is a Beta, so some rough edges are expected.
